vocab.sentence: In high school, Harvey’s favorite subject was biology because he was interested in learning about different creatures.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 高中時，Harvey 最喜歡的科目是生物學，因為他對了解不同生物很感興趣。

vocab.sentence: The unique appearance of these cupcakes makes them popular among teenagers.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些杯子蛋糕獨特的外觀讓它們很受青少年歡迎。

vocab.sentence: The boss thanked the staff for their hard work and treated them to a big meal.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老闆感謝全體員工的辛勞，並請他們吃了一頓大餐。

vocab.sentence: We spent an hour interacting with the animals.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了一個小時與動物互動。

vocab.sentence: The library’s regular hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 圖書館平日的正常開放時間是上午 9 點到下午 5 點。

vocab.sentence: Ashley did not return the book on time, so she had to pay a late fee of NT$100.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ashley 沒有準時還書，所以必須支付新臺幣 100 元的逾期費用。

vocab.sentence: Ella used the money she saved from the discount on tickets to pay for her hotel room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ella 用買票打折所省下的錢支付旅館房費。

vocab.chinese: 行程表；時刻表；安排；排定日程
vocab.sentence: I won’t be able to meet you for lunch because I have a very busy schedule today.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我今天行程很滿，沒辦法和你一起吃午餐。

vocab.sentence: The team’s arrival at the meeting was delayed due to traffic on the highway.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 球隊因公路上的交通狀況而延遲抵達會場。

vocab.sentence: When a train goes into a tunnel, passengers can see nothing but darkness outside the window.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 火車進入隧道時，乘客從窗外只能看到一片黑暗。

vocab.sentence: Tina bought a coffee mug as a souvenir of London.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Tina 買了一個咖啡杯，作為倫敦之旅的紀念品。

vocab.sentence: It usually takes four years to finish university in Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在臺灣，大學畢業通常需要四年。

vocab.sentence: Emma is planning to retire from her company because she is already sixty-five years old.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Emma 已經 65 歲，正計畫從公司退休。

vocab.sentence: The rain had lasted two hours when we left.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離開時，雨已經下了兩個小時。

vocab.sentence: The elementary school photo brings back lots of memories of Steven’s childhood.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這張小學照片勾起 Steven 許多童年回憶。

vocab.sentence: Traveling alone was an unforgettable experience for Cindy. She learned a lot during her trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 獨自旅行對 Cindy 來說是難忘的經驗，她在旅途中學到很多。

vocab.sentence: Going on a working holiday to America was a great adventure for Ian.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 去美國打工度假對 Ian 而言是一場很棒的冒險。

vocab.sentence: Many families have lived in this small town for generations. They don’t want to move away.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 許多家庭已在這個小鎮住了好幾代，他們不想搬走。

phrases.sentence: We hurried up because the movie had already started.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們加快腳步，因為電影已經開始了。

phrases.sentence: I used to spend Sundays with my grandparents.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我以前常和爺爺奶奶一起度過星期天。

phrases.sentence: Ivy was so tired that she fell asleep on the sofa.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Ivy 太累了，在沙發上睡著了。

phrases.sentence: Dad spent the night watching over the baby.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 爸爸花了一整晚照顧寶寶。

tips.label: spend：人花時間或金錢
tips.text: 人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋V-ing；也可用 on＋名詞。過去式、過去分詞都是 spent。

tips.label: cost：本課用來表示花錢
tips.text: 事物＋cost（＋人）＋金錢；It costs（＋人）＋金錢＋to V。cost 的過去式、過去分詞仍是 cost。

tips.label: take：做事需要時間
tips.text: 事情＋take（＋人）＋時間；It takes（＋人）＋時間＋to V。過去式是 took，過去分詞是 taken。

tips.label: 過去完成式：先找過去的參考點
tips.text: had＋過去分詞表示在過去某時之前已完成、已持續一段時間或曾有的經驗。had 不隨主詞人稱改變。

notes.title: spend：人是主詞，動作接 V-ing
notes.rule:
人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋V-ing
人＋spend＋時間／金錢＋on＋名詞
notes.description: 先看主詞是不是人，再看花的是時間還是金錢。spend 後若接動作，用 V-ing；若接物品或事情的名稱，可以用 on＋名詞。不要混用 It takes ... to V 的句型。
examples: We spent an hour studying biology.（我們花了一個小時讀生物。）
Leo spent two hundred dollars on a souvenir.（Leo 花了兩百元買紀念品。）
Leo spent two hundred dollars buying a souvenir.（Leo 花了兩百元買紀念品。）

notes.title: cost：物品的價格或做事所需的費用
notes.rule:
事物＋cost（＋人）＋金錢
It＋cost（＋人）＋金錢＋to V
notes.description: 本課重點是用 cost 表示金錢花費。物品可直接當主詞；若要說做某件事花多少錢，可用 It cost ... to V。單數主詞的現在式用 costs；過去式和過去分詞都用 cost。
examples: The two tickets cost us four hundred dollars yesterday.（昨天兩張票花了我們四百元。）
It cost us four hundred dollars to buy the tickets.（買這些票花了我們四百元。）
A ticket usually costs two hundred dollars.（一張票通常要兩百元。）

notes.title: take：用事情或 it 當主詞
notes.rule:
事情＋take（＋人）＋時間
It＋take（＋人）＋時間＋to V
notes.description: 描述完成某件事需要多少時間時，可以把 V-ing 片語當主詞，也可以用 It takes ... to V。不要把兩種句型的動詞形式混在一起；It took us an hour 後面要接 to V。
examples: Walking through the tunnel took us ten minutes.（走過隧道花了我們十分鐘。）
It took us ten minutes to walk through the tunnel.（我們花了十分鐘走過隧道。）
It takes the staff an hour to clean the room.（工作人員需要一個小時清理房間。）

notes.title: 花費動詞的三態與助動詞
notes.rule:
spend → spent → spent
cost → cost → cost
take → took → taken
did／did not 後接原形動詞
notes.description: yesterday、last year 等可提供過去時間線索。疑問句或否定句已經有 did 時，主要動詞用原形，不能再用 spent 或 took。表示花錢的 cost 也不要寫成 costed。
examples: How much did you spend on the trip?（你在這趟旅行花了多少錢？）
It did not take us long to get there.（我們沒花多久就到了。）
The trip did not cost much.（這趟旅行沒有花很多錢。）

notes.title: 過去完成式：先發生的事
notes.rule:
主詞＋had＋過去分詞（Vpp）
過去較早的事件：had＋Vpp
較晚的過去事件：通常用過去簡單式
notes.description: 先找敘事中的過去參考點，再判斷哪些事情在那之前已發生。had 不隨 I、he、they 等主詞改變。had 後接過去分詞，例如 seen、gone、fallen，不是 saw、went、fell。
examples: When we reached the museum, the tour had already started.（我們到博物館時，導覽已經開始了。）
The staff had checked the tickets before the bus left.（公車離開前，工作人員已經檢查過票券。）
I could not enter my room because I had left my key at school.（我進不了房間，因為我把鑰匙留在學校了。）

notes.title: 過去完成式也能表示持續與經驗
notes.rule:
had＋Vpp＋for＋一段時間
had already＋Vpp
had never＋Vpp
notes.description: 除了已完成的動作，也能表達持續到過去某時的狀態或之前的經驗。for ten years 表示持續時間；never 表示直到那個過去時點都沒有過。for 本身不是過去完成式的專屬標記，仍須看整段時間背景。
examples: By 2020, my grandparents had lived here for thirty years.（到 2020 年時，祖父母已在這裡住了三十年。）
Before that adventure, I had never seen a shark.（那次冒險之前，我從未見過鯊魚。）
By noon yesterday, the rain had lasted four hours.（到昨天中午時，雨已經下了四個小時。）

notes.title: 過去完成式的否定句與問句
notes.rule:
否定：主詞＋had not＋Vpp
問句：Had＋主詞＋Vpp ...?
簡答：Yes, 主詞＋had.／No, 主詞＋had not.
notes.description: 否定句在 had 後加 not；問句把 had 放到主詞前。had not 可以縮寫成 hadn’t。這些句型仍須有明確的過去背景。
examples: I had not bought a ticket when the show began.（表演開始時，我還沒買票。）
Had you visited the museum before that school trip?（那次校外教學之前，你去過這間博物館嗎？）
Yes, I had.（是的，我去過。）

notes.title: 時間子句的位置與先後判斷
notes.rule:
Before＋過去事件，主詞＋had＋Vpp.
主詞＋had＋Vpp＋before＋過去事件.
By the time＋過去事件，主詞＋had＋Vpp.
notes.description: before、when 子句常可放在前面或後面；子句在前時通常加逗號。不能只因為子句位置不同就判成錯句。看到 before 或 when 也不代表一定要用過去完成式，應依語意判斷；有些情境用過去簡單式也自然。本課練習會提供明確時間線索，避免兩個選項都合理。
examples: Before the bus arrived, we had packed our bags.（公車抵達前，我們已經收好行李。）
We had packed our bags before the bus arrived.（公車抵達前，我們已經收好行李。）
By the time we arrived, the shop had closed.（我們抵達時，商店已經關門了。）

quiz.question: It cost our class six hundred dollars ___ a bus for the museum trip.
quiz.hint: It cost＋人＋金錢後接 to V；租車花的是六百元，因此用 to rent。rent 漏了 to，rented 和 renting 都不符合這個句型。

quiz.question: Mei spent half an hour ___ the tour schedule.
quiz.hint: spent＋時間後接 V-ing，所以用 reading。to read 是混用了 It takes ... to V 的句型。

quiz.question: Finding the tunnel entrance ___ us ten minutes yesterday.
quiz.hint: Finding the tunnel entrance 是一件事，ten minutes 是時間；yesterday 表示過去，用 took。spent 的主詞應是花時間的人。

quiz.question: How much did you ___ on that unique souvenir yesterday?
quiz.hint: 人花錢買物品用 spend ... on ...；問句已有 did，後面必須用原形 spend，不能再用 spent。

quiz.question: The two museum tickets ___ us four hundred dollars yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞是兩張票，後接人與金額，用 cost；yesterday 表示過去，表示價格的 cost 過去式仍是 cost。

quiz.question: When we reached the museum yesterday, the guide ___ already left.
quiz.hint: 抵達是過去參考點，導覽員在那之前已離開，用 had already left；不能用現在完成式的 has 或 have。

quiz.question: Before her first ocean adventure, Mia had never ___ a shark.
quiz.hint: had never 後接過去分詞，表示那次冒險之前的經驗；see 的過去分詞是 seen，不是 saw。

quiz.question: I could not get into my room last night because I ___ left my key on the bus.
quiz.hint: 先把鑰匙留在公車上，之後才進不了房間；較早的事用 had left，參考點是 last night。

quiz.question: By the time the show began, the visitors had ___ their seats.
quiz.hint: had 後面需要過去分詞；take 的三態是 take、took、taken，因此用 taken。

quiz.question: When my brother started university in 2019, our family ___ lived in Kaohsiung for ten years.
quiz.hint: 到 2019 年入學這個過去時點，已在高雄住了十年，使用 had lived；for ten years 表示持續時間。

quiz.question: At its regular price, this souvenir ___ two hundred dollars.
quiz.hint: 描述一般售價，單數主詞 this souvenir 用現在式 costs。這裡表示價格，不能用 costed；costing 和 to cost 也不能單獨作主要動詞。

quiz.question: It takes the staff an hour ___ the fish tanks every morning.
quiz.hint: It takes＋人＋時間後接 to V，因此用 to clean。cleaning 是混用了 spend 的句型。

quiz.question: We spent our last morning at the museum ___ with the guide.
quiz.hint: spent＋時間後面的動作用 V-ing，因此用 interacting；at the museum 不會改變 spend 的句型。

quiz.question: ___ the university by bus took us forty minutes yesterday.
quiz.hint: 空格所在的整個片語作主詞，要用動名詞 Reaching；Reaching the university 表示到達大學這件事。

quiz.question: It cost us eight hundred dollars ___ the broken camera before our trip.
quiz.hint: It cost＋人＋金錢後接 to V，因此用 to fix；不能直接接 fix 或 fixing。

quiz.question: By the time we arrived yesterday, the staff ___ already fed the fish.
quiz.hint: 到昨天抵達時，餵魚已完成，用 had already fed。had 不會因為主詞是 staff 而改成 has。

quiz.question: By noon yesterday, the storm had ___ for four hours.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞，last 的過去分詞是 lasted；for four hours 表示到昨天中午已持續四小時。

quiz.question: Before that trip, Ellie had never ___ a night at a museum.
quiz.hint: had never 後接過去分詞；spend 的過去分詞是 spent，表示那趟旅行之前沒有過這種經驗。

quiz.question: Last Friday, our guide told us that his grandfather ___ retired five years earlier.
quiz.hint: 退休發生在上週五告知之前五年，用 had retired；five years earlier 表示比那個過去時點更早。

quiz.question: When we opened the aquarium map, the children had already ___ asleep.
quiz.hint: had already 後接過去分詞；fall 的過去分詞是 fallen，不能用過去式 fell。

quiz.question: Grandpa ___ two hours watching the fish yesterday.
quiz.hint: 主詞 Grandpa 是人，後接時間與 watching，用 spend 句型；yesterday 表示過去，因此選 spent。

quiz.question: How long does it ___ to walk through the tunnel?
quiz.hint: It takes ... to V 表示做事需要時間；問句已有助動詞 does，後面用原形 take。

quiz.question: We did not ___ much money on the tickets because we got a discount.
quiz.hint: 人＋spend＋金錢＋on＋名詞；did not 後面用原形 spend，不能再用 spent。

quiz.question: It usually ___ my brother twenty minutes to fall asleep.
quiz.hint: It takes＋人＋時間＋to V；usually 表示一般習慣，主詞 It 為第三人稱單數，用 takes。

quiz.question: Last summer, the adventure camp ___ us three thousand dollars.
quiz.hint: 主詞是營隊，後接人與金額；Last summer 表示過去，表示費用的 cost 過去式仍是 cost。

quiz.question: A: Why was Lucy worried about yesterday’s trip? B: She ___ never traveled alone before that day.
quiz.hint: 參考點是昨天的旅行，在那之前沒有獨自旅行的經驗，用 had never traveled。

quiz.question: The tourists could not buy any postcards because the shop had ___ all of them.
quiz.hint: had 後面要接過去分詞 sold；明信片先賣完，旅客後來才買不到。

quiz.question: When I reached the entrance yesterday, I realized I ___ brought my ticket. It was still at home.
quiz.hint: 票還在家裡，表示在抵達之前沒有帶票；過去完成式否定用 had not brought。do not 後不能接 brought。

quiz.question: When Mom returned yesterday, Dad had ___ over the baby for six hours.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞 watched；for six hours 說明照顧寶寶已持續到媽媽回來時六小時。

quiz.question: At the museum yesterday, Ella asked me whether I ___ seen that kind of fish before.
quiz.hint: 問話發生在昨天，詢問的是在那之前的經驗，用 had seen；不能改用現在完成式。

quiz.question: How much money did the adventure camp ___ you last year?
quiz.hint: 主詞是營隊，花費的是金錢，用 cost；問句已有 did，後面的 cost 用原形。

quiz.question: I spent fifty dollars ___ a notebook for my biology class.
quiz.hint: spend＋金錢後接動作時用 V-ing，因此用 buying；to buy 是混用了 It cost ... to V。

quiz.question: It took us a whole afternoon ___ our biology project.
quiz.hint: It took＋人＋時間後接 to V，因此用 to finish；finishing 應搭配人＋spent＋時間。

quiz.question: The staff ___ an hour checking tickets yesterday morning.
quiz.hint: 主詞 staff 是花時間的工作人員，後接 checking；yesterday morning 表示過去，使用 spent。

quiz.question: It did not ___ us any money to enter the university museum.
quiz.hint: It cost ... to V 表示費用；did not 已表達過去與否定，後面用原形 cost。

quiz.question: ___ you ever visited an aquarium before that school trip last year?
quiz.hint: 詢問去年校外教學之前的經驗，用 Had＋主詞＋過去分詞；Have you visited 是現在完成式，與這個過去參考點不符。

quiz.question: Before you moved to Taipei in 2020, how long ___ your parents lived in Kaohsiung?
quiz.hint: 詢問截至 2020 年搬家之前已居住多久，使用 had lived；did 後應接原形，不能接 lived。

quiz.question: We knew the story well because we had ___ it several times before that visit.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞 heard；several times before that visit 表示那次參觀以前已聽過多次。

quiz.question: By the end of last month, my great-grandfather ___ lived in this town for ninety years.
quiz.hint: 參考點是上個月底，到那時已住九十年，用 had lived。for ninety years 表示持續時間。

quiz.question: They ___ not bought any souvenirs when we left the shop yesterday.
quiz.hint: 昨天離開商店時，他們還沒買紀念品，用 had not bought；do not 後面不能接過去分詞 bought。

quiz.question: A: Did you spend an hour reading the schedule? B: No, I ___ only ten minutes reading it.
quiz.hint: 回答的是已發生的花費時間，完整肯定句沒有 did，因此主要動詞要用過去式 spent。

quiz.question: The university museum charges an entrance fee. It ___ each visitor fifty dollars to get in.
quiz.hint: 描述現在的入場費用，用 It costs＋人＋金錢＋to V；It 為單數主詞，用 costs。costed 不能表示這裡的價格；to cost 和 costing 不能單獨作主要動詞。

quiz.question: My sister spends her free time ___ stories about ocean adventures.
quiz.hint: spends＋時間後接 V-ing，因此用 writing；不接 to write 或過去分詞 written。

quiz.question: ___ to the museum by train took two hours yesterday.
quiz.hint: 整個 Traveling to the museum by train 當主詞，表示搭火車去博物館這件事，因此用動名詞 Traveling。

quiz.question: It took the visitors ten minutes ___ the souvenir shop.
quiz.hint: It took＋人＋時間後接 to V，因此用 to find；不能因為前面 took 是過去式就把 find 也改成 found。

quiz.question: Dad could not remember the room number yesterday because he had ___ it.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞；forget 的過去分詞是 forgotten，不是過去式 forgot。

quiz.question: By the time we got on the bus, the staff had ___ our bags inside.
quiz.hint: had 後接過去分詞；put 的原形、過去式和過去分詞都是 put。

quiz.question: A: Had your grandmother retired before you started school? B: Yes, she ___.
quiz.hint: 問句使用 Had＋主詞＋過去分詞，肯定簡答也使用 had；不能改用 has 或 did。

quiz.question: At ten last night, my parents ___ already gone to bed.
quiz.hint: 到昨晚十點這個過去時點，父母已經去睡覺，用 had already gone。主詞即使是複數也用 had。

quiz.question: The staff had checked our tickets before the bus ___ at nine yesterday.
quiz.hint: 驗票先發生，用 had checked；公車昨天九點離開是較晚的過去事件，這個子句用過去式 left。

vocab.sentence: In high school, Harvey’s favorite subject was biology because he was interested in learning about different creatures.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 高中時，Harvey 最喜歡的科目是生物學，因為他對了解不同生物很感興趣。

vocab.sentence: The unique appearance of these cupcakes makes them popular among teenagers.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些杯子蛋糕獨特的外觀讓它們很受青少年歡迎。

vocab.sentence: The boss thanked the staff for their hard work and treated them to a big meal.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老闆感謝全體員工的辛勞，並請他們吃了一頓大餐。

vocab.sentence: We spent an hour interacting with the animals.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們花了一個小時與動物互動。

vocab.sentence: The library’s regular hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 圖書館平日的正常開放時間是上午 9 點到下午 5 點。

vocab.sentence: Ashley did not return the book on time, so she had to pay a late fee of NT$100.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ashley 沒有準時還書，所以必須支付新臺幣 100 元的逾期費用。

vocab.sentence: Ella used the money she saved from the discount on tickets to pay for her hotel room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ella 用買票打折所省下的錢支付旅館房費。

vocab.sentence: I won’t be able to meet you for lunch because I have a very busy schedule today.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我今天行程很滿，沒辦法和你一起吃午餐。

vocab.sentence: The team’s arrival at the meeting was delayed due to traffic on the highway.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 球隊因公路上的交通狀況而延遲抵達會場。

vocab.sentence: When a train goes into a tunnel, passengers can see nothing but darkness outside the window.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 火車進入隧道時，乘客從窗外只能看到一片黑暗。

vocab.sentence: Tina bought a coffee mug as a souvenir of London.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Tina 買了一個咖啡杯，作為倫敦之旅的紀念品。

vocab.sentence: It usually takes four years to finish university in Taiwan.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在臺灣，大學畢業通常需要四年。

vocab.sentence: Emma is planning to retire from her company because she is already sixty-five years old.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Emma 已經 65 歲，正計畫從公司退休。

vocab.sentence: The rain had lasted two hours when we left.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離開時，雨已經下了兩個小時。

vocab.sentence: The elementary school photo brings back lots of memories of Steven’s childhood.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這張小學照片勾起 Steven 許多童年回憶。

vocab.sentence: Traveling alone was an unforgettable experience for Cindy. She learned a lot during her trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 獨自旅行對 Cindy 來說是難忘的經驗，她在旅途中學到很多。

vocab.sentence: Going on a working holiday to America was a great adventure for Ian.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 去美國打工度假對 Ian 而言是一場很棒的冒險。

vocab.sentence: Many families have lived in this small town for generations. They don’t want to move away.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 許多家庭已在這個小鎮住了好幾代，他們不想搬走。

phrases.sentence: We hurried up because the movie had already started.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們加快腳步，因為電影已經開始了。

phrases.sentence: I used to spend Sundays with my grandparents.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我以前常和爺爺奶奶一起度過星期天。

phrases.sentence: Ivy was so tired that she fell asleep on the sofa.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Ivy 太累了，在沙發上睡著了。

phrases.sentence: Dad spent the night watching over the baby.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 爸爸花了一整晚照顧寶寶。

grammar.sentence: We spent an hour studying biology together.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了一個小時一起讀生物。

grammar.sentence: The guide had left before our arrival.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們抵達前，導覽員已經離開了。

grammar.sentence: It took us ten minutes to reach the tunnel.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了十分鐘到達隧道。

grammar.sentence: The souvenir cost me two hundred dollars.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個紀念品花了我兩百元。

grammar.sentence: Before that adventure, I had never seen a shark.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那次冒險之前，我從未見過鯊魚。

grammar.sentence: We had paid the fee before the tour began.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 導覽開始前，我們已經付了費用。

grammar.sentence: Mei spent thirty minutes reading the schedule.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Mei 花了三十分鐘閱讀行程表。

grammar.sentence: It cost us fifty dollars to print the photos.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 列印這些照片花了我們五十元。

grammar.sentence: By noon yesterday, the rain had lasted four hours.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 到昨天中午時，雨已經下了四個小時。

grammar.sentence: Walking through the tunnel took us five minutes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 走過隧道花了我們五分鐘。

grammar.sentence: Had you visited the museum before that trip?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那趟旅行之前，你參觀過那間博物館嗎？

grammar.sentence: Grandpa had retired before I started school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我開始上學前，爺爺已經退休了。

grammar.sentence: Dad spent the night watching over the baby.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸花了一整晚照顧寶寶。

grammar.sentence: I realized I had forgotten my ticket at home.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我發現自己把票忘在家裡了。

grammar.sentence: The two tickets cost us four hundred dollars.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這兩張票花了我們四百元。

grammar.sentence: It takes the staff an hour to clean the room.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 工作人員需要一個小時清理房間。

grammar.sentence: My sister had fallen asleep before the movie ended.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 電影結束前，我妹妹已經睡著了。

grammar.sentence: The shop had sold every souvenir before we arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們抵達前，商店已經賣光所有紀念品。

grammar.sentence: How much did you spend on the adventure?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你在這次冒險花了多少錢？

grammar.sentence: We spent an unforgettable evening at the museum.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們在博物館度過了難忘的一晚。

grammar.sentence: By 2020, three generations had lived in this house.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 到 2020 年時，已有三代住過這間房子。

grammar.sentence: I had not bought anything when the shop closed.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 商店關門時，我還沒買任何東西。

grammar.sentence: It took my brother twenty minutes to fall asleep.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我弟弟花了二十分鐘才睡著。

grammar.sentence: The staff had fed the fish before we arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們抵達前，工作人員已經餵過魚了。

grammar.sentence: I used to spend Sundays with my grandparents.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我以前常和爺爺奶奶一起度過星期天。

grammar.sentence: The guide had explained the discount before we bought tickets.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們買票前，導覽員已經說明過折扣。

grammar.sentence: It did not cost much to buy the souvenir.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 買這個紀念品沒有花很多錢。

grammar.sentence: We hurried up because the tour had already started.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們加快腳步，因為導覽已經開始了。

grammar.sentence: We spent an hour interacting with the animals.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們花了一個小時與動物互動。

grammar.sentence: The children had never visited a university before that day.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那天之前，孩子們從未參觀過大學。
